answer: A sybil tax blocks fake identities with a non-refundable entry fee. Each agent burns 5 POA to join, and a cipher signature ties the payment to one identity, so one operator cannot reuse a single fee across many accounts. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 5,000 POA, while an honest agent pays 5 POA once. Like an island with one narrow bridge, the fee turns a cheap flood into an expensive trickle, so honest agents keep rewards undiluted and burned fees fund an opal audit reserve.
